# IPlatformService

**Interface** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Core/IPlatformService.cs#L9)

What the framework expects of a platform module: the handshake with whatever LMS or launcher
started the session - its parameters, the language it asks for, and the report and completion
it expects back. Obtained from [`RuntimeRegistry`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/RuntimeRegistry).

```csharp
public interface IPlatformService
```

**Derived:** [`PlatformManager`](/api/vrframework-platform-runtime/PlatformManager)

### SendReport() {#sendreport}

Queues a report of everything contributed so far - see [`PlatformReport`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/PlatformReport) for
what that is. The session end sends one by itself, so this is for apps that want to
report before then. Reports are delivered one at a time, in the order they were made.

```csharp
void SendReport()
```
